DEFECT.what: it implemented a LOWER weighted median, which does not reproduce the frozen theta functional even under unit weights

evidence.worked_case: v=[1,2,3,4] unit weights -> np.median 2.5 vs lower weighted median 2.0

DEFECT.consequence_if_shipped: the CI would have been an interval for a DIFFERENT quantity than the point estimate

CORRECTION.name: WEIGHTED_MEDIAN_V2
CORRECTION.SEMANTIC_AUTHORITY: construct the conceptual expanded multiset in which v_i appears exactly w_i times; return the ORDINARY sample median of that multiset, using the SAME convention as np.median (odd N -> central observation; even N -> arithmetic mean of the two central observations)
efficient_form: cw = cumulative integer weight over value-sorted rows
if W even and some POSITIVE-weight row i ends exactly at W/2: j = next row after i with w_j > 0; median = (v_i + v_j)/2
else: j = first row with cw_j > W/2; median = v_j
CORRECTION.INVARIANT: w_i = 1 for all i  =>  BIT-IDENTICAL to the frozen ordinary-median functional (verified on 50,000 random cases, 0 mismatches)
CORRECTION.zero_weight_rows: neither replicated nor selectable — the question is closed by construction

VERIFICATION.oracle_note: np.median(np.repeat(v,w)) is the SEMANTIC ORACLE ONLY and must NEVER be used in production

RETAINED_NEGATIVE_FINDING.claim_made: a zero-weight row could be returned as the weighted median
RETAINED_NEGATIVE_FINDING.proof: w[i]=0 implies cw[i]=cw[i-1], so searchsorted(side='left') can never select i unless an earlier index already satisfied the condition
RETAINED_NEGATIVE_FINDING.why_retained: a suspected defect that was MEASURED and DISPROVEN must not be silently forgotten

CI_STABILITY_GATE.REJECTED_ALTERNATIVE: computing a percentile CI from the surviving draws (e.g. 1983 of 2000)
CI_STABILITY_GATE.why_rejected: that reinstates a variable-support procedure and would require inventing a 'min_defined_bootstrap_draws' threshold after the fact
CI_STABILITY_GATE.empty_group_behaviour: explicit status, NEVER an exception — the old primitive raised IndexError on empty input while returning NaN for all-zero weights, two different behaviours for one situation
